6.40 rsInvalidEmbeddedImageNameLength
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidEmbeddedImageNameLength is a critical error that will occur whenever the Name attribute
of an EmbeddedImage element has a value that is empty or greater than 256 characters in length.
